_about: Persistent editing rules for the Fan Economy reel editor. Numbers here are read by the code on every run; the prose taste rules live in .claude/skills/fan-economy-reel-editor/RULES.md. Change a number here, rerun `npm run reel -- plan <n>` and `render`, and every future video inherits it. Seeded 2026-09-24 from studio/Shortform_Video_Process.txt (the founder's own assembly habits) plus short-form conventions; every value is a starting point, not a law.

safeZone._about: Instagram/TikTok/Shorts chrome: header on top, caption + buttons at the bottom, action rail on the right. Text never goes outside this box.

transcription._provider: auto = ElevenLabs Scribe when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set, otherwise local faster-whisper. Scribe keeps disfluencies verbatim, which is what retake detection needs.

takes._lastTakeBonus: Founder habit: 'if I said something three times I keep the last one, because the last one is when I got it right.' A later complete take wins a near-tie.

pacing._about: Pauses the clean cut leaves between phrases, in seconds of source room tone. Natural, not robotic: breaths under keepPauseMaxSec inside a take are left alone.

visual._minFaceRatio: Share of the reel where the founder's face is on screen (full, punch or split). He is the trust in these videos.

audio._musicUnderVoiceDb: Founder habit: the bed is very low and always the same level. Voice must win by this many LU.
audio._hookDropSec: Founder habit: drop the beat from the middle of the hook's last sentence until speech resumes, and a riser peaks exactly where the beat drops.
